mapper.select: SELECT pi.id, pi.order_id as orderId, pi.sku_id as skuId, pi.quantity, pi.purchase_price as purchasePrice, pi.subtotal, pi.production_date as productionDate, pi.expiry_date as expiryDate, pi.batch_no as batchNo, pi.create_at as createAt, pi.update_at as updateAt, pi.is_delete as isDelete, sku.sku_code as skuCode, sku.sku_name as skuName FROM e_wms_purchase_item pi LEFT JOIN e_wms_sku sku ON pi.sku_id = sku.id WHERE pi.order_id = #{orderId} AND pi.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY pi.id ASC
